description.html: On this model the 30 cm width is almost equal to the 35 cm length, so the floor has 1050 cm². The height is 25 cm, the volume about 26.3 liters. On the back is a 3D styrofoam background, and ventilation is via mesh vents.

The wider floor gives more options for the layout: a hide can stand in front of the background too, not only to the left and right. A juvenile leopard gecko thus gets a warm, a cool and a humid spot. A young corn snake has room to make a circuit of the terrarium. Crested, gargoyle and day geckos use the background, but 25 cm of height suits them only while they are small.

For the same species as adults, our range has the 45x35x35 and 50x35x35. We can also build a taller version of this floor, for example 35x30x40. You choose the film pattern when ordering, and we send the package by courier. A taller version or another size is finished in 7 to 14 days.
